text:
anna (product): quick question — before we flip the new smart-routing rollout, we need a final contract for SDK/API routing params + telemetry. can we decide header names + precedence?

john (platform): agree. current draft: advisory `X-RW-Region`, `X-RW-Tier`, and a `X-RW-Debug` query/header for internal debugging. but we never nailed precedence between SDK-level overrides and headers.

maya (sdk): prefer SDK-level explicit override to win over per-request headers (so a client that sets `client.setRouting({tier: 'beta'})` should be able to lock routing). but allow per-request header to override if SDK opts in with `allowHeaderOverrides: true`. smaller surface for users.

sami (devex): +1. UX-wise console should default SDK to not allow overrides. add an account-level flag in console to opt-in.

john (platform): ok that gives us precedence: SDK override -> header (if allowed) -> account default -> auto region pick. also need to decide if `X-RW-Tier` is authoritative (force) vs advisory. i'm leaning advisory except for enterprise dedicated lanes.

eva (sre): for safety, critical customers (dedicated) should have a `force-tier` policy enabled server-side. we must enforce at gateway for SLA customers. non-dedicated: treat header as hint.

leo (telemetry): telemetry side: emit `route.hint_provided` (bool), `route.final_tier` (string), `route.fallback_model` (string), and `route.reason` (enum: capacity, geo, quota, policy). sample event name `inference.route_resolution.v1`. include `sdk_override=true/false`.

maya (sdk): can we also log `override_source` with values `sdk, header, account, auto`? makes debugging easier.

leo (telemetry): yup. also we should sample full debug traces behind a flag to avoid noise: `route.debug_sampled` and a trace id when sampled.

anna (product): console UX: show the resolved routing on the request details page + a dropdown for "Why this route?" that surfaces the fields you mentioned. require audit log for any header-based force changes. tia (console): i'll mock screens — will include a small chip: "Resolved: eu-west-1 • enterprise (header hint)" with link to trace.

john (platform): security note: `X-RW-Debug` must be ignored for external customers unless an account-level debug token is present. otherwise users could probe fallbacks. throw 403 if they attempt a force that requires entitlements.

maya (sdk): technical header example for docs:
```
POST /v1/generate
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer ...
X-RW-Region: eu-west-1
X-RW-Tier: beta
X-RW-Debug: route=canary;log=summary
```
and SDK sample: `client = new RWClient({allowHeaderOverrides: false, routing: {tier: 'enterprise'}})`

john (platform): fallback behavior: prefer same-arch model variants in same region; if not available, fallback order = local compatible quantized variant -> remote region same-tier -> remote region lower-tier (with telemetry tag). include `route.fallback_chain` array in trace when fallback happens.

eva (sre): quota enforcement: enforce per-account tier quotas at ingress before routing. if quota exhausted and fallback would hit a lower-tier that is allowed, we should include `route.reason=quota` and mark `quota_fallback=true`. also surface quota_remaining in trace.

anna (product): rollout plan: canary 1% of requests for accounts in the beta cohort for 48h, sample 100% of debug traces for canary account IDs, and add console alerting on `route.fallback_rate > 0.5%` for first week.

leo (telemetry): I'll add metric names: `inference.route.resolve_count`, `inference.route.fallback_count`, `inference.route.fallback_rate` and a dashboard tile with `percentile(latency) by final_tier`.

tia (console): UI todo: expose "Allow header overrides" toggle per API key, with audit trail + reason text. also show a small badge when `sdk_override` is in effect.

maya (sdk): doc note: SDK will not transmit `X-RW-Debug` unless `enableDebugHeader=true` during client init; default false.

john (platform): action items: 1) platform: implement precedence/enforcement + quota precheck (john, eva) 2) telemetry: add events + dashboard (leo) 3) sdk: implement `allowHeaderOverrides` + debug gating (maya) 4) console: opt-in toggles + resolved-route UI + audit (tia) 5) product: finalize rollout cohort + alerts (anna).

anna (product): timeline: aim for beta rollout next Tue if all done by EOD Fri.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: smart-routing/v2 precedence-fix -> staging (sha: abcd123).

john (platform): I'll kick off staging QA once deploy finishes.

maya (sdk): I'll start a small doc PR and add code samples for the new headers.

leo (telemetry): Adding dashboard skeleton now, will ping when ready for review. :eyes:

anna (product): thanks team — follow-ups in this thread. :thumbsup:
